checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includesText names arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only the Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as a mandatory overhead fee; no second mandatory facilities or staff fee appears.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so they are in immediate conjunction by page.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service; the embalming text is the prescribed may-be-necessary-if-viewing wording.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container, and unfinished wood box options; no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation entries have no description of whether the crematory fee is included and no cash-advance listing for a crematory fee, so no inconsistency is shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all appear with their own prices, and no other offered good or service lacks its own line-item price.
The list contains no optional combination package; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are required items, not packages.
No text asserts a purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory beyond the prescribed disclosure wording, which is not a concern.
No text claims goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no disclosure is shown printed in a way that is hard to notice.
